name: loops
description: Email marketing, transactional email, and email automation for SaaS. Build waitlist, onboarding, trial, and dunning emails, draft campaigns, and manage contacts with Loops.

interface.longDescription: Skills for SaaS email with Loops: waitlist, welcome, onboarding, trial ending, dunning, and win-back emails, plus campaigns, newsletters, and transactional email. Covers the Loops API and SDKs for Next.js server routes and other Node backends, the Loops CLI, LMX email markup, and email deliverability.
defaultPrompt: Add Loops to my app and send a signup event from the server.
Build a failed payment (dunning) email workflow in Loops.
Design a new welcome email with an imagegen reference, then write it in LMX.
